title: Dan Ives Is Still Bullish on Nvidia: ‘We’re in the 3rd Inning of the AI Revolution,’ and Demand Is Outpacing Supply “12 to 1”
excerpt: Tech skeptics say the AI rally is running on fumes, but one Wall Street analyst sees a demand imbalance so extreme it suggests the buildout has barely starte...
content_html:
Quick Read

  • Dan Ives cites a 12-to-1 demand-to-supply ratio for NVIDIA chips, backed by $82B in Q1 revenue and $91B Q2 guidance.

  • Meta raised its 2026 capex guidance to a range of $125B to $145B, while Alphabet's AI buildout drove its first negative free cash flow in 22 years.

  • Ives says the industry is only 15% through total AI spending, with prediction markets giving Amazon a 95% chance of beating next earnings.

  • Don't wait: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just revealed his top 10 AI stocks. See the full list FREE now.

Dan Ives, Partner and Senior Managing Director at Yorkville Ives & Co., took to CNBC on July 27, 2026 to push back on the growing chorus of tech skeptics. His central message: the recent pullback in high-growth names is a digestion period, and the AI investment cycle is nowhere near its late stages. "We're third inning of the AI revolution and it's just further validation from earnings," Ives said.

The backdrop matters. The Nasdaq 100 is trading at 22 times forward P/E, a nearly 10% discount to its ten-year average, and sits 8% below June 2026 highs. Volatility has ticked up modestly, with the VIX at 18.70 as of July 23, 2026, still inside the normal range. Ives's framing is that this is exactly what a healthy consolidation looks like inside a multi-year buildout.

The NVIDIA Thesis: One Chip, 12-to-1 Demand

NVIDIA (NASDAQ:NVDA) sits at the center of Ives's argument. "There's one chip in the world fueling the AI revolution, and that's Nvidia," he said, adding that "Demand to supply today is 12 to 1 for their chips. Physical AI hasn't even started to play out."

Don't wait: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just revealed his top 10 AI stocks. See the full list FREE now.

The most recent numbers give that view some weight. In Q1 FY2027, NVIDIA posted revenue of $81.61 billion, up 85.2% year over year, and non-GAAP EPS of $1.87 versus a $1.77 estimate. Data Center revenue reached $75.25 billion, up 92% year over year, with Data Center Networking climbing 199% year over year to $14.80 billion. Management guided Q2 FY27 revenue to $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, excluding China Data Center compute. Total supply commitments now stand at $119.0 billion, disclosed in the company's Q1 FY27 8-K filing.

CEO Jensen Huang described the moment as "the buildout of AI factories, the largest infrastructure expansion in human history, is accelerating at extraordinary speed." NVIDIA shares closed at $206.84 on July 24, and the stock is up 11.04% year to date. Forward P/E sits at 24, with a consensus analyst target of $302.83.

Yorkville Ives & Co. 合伙人兼高级董事总经理 Dan Ives 于 2026 年 7 月 27 日接受 CNBC 采访，驳斥了日益高涨的科技怀疑论者的声音。 他的中心思想是：近期高增长企业的回调是消化期，人工智能投资周期还远未到后期。 “我们正处于人工智能革命的第三局，这只是收益的进一步验证，”艾夫斯说。

背景很重要。 纳斯达克 100 指数的预期市盈率为 22 倍，较十年平均水平低近 10%，较 2026 年 6 月高点低 8%。 波动性小幅上升，截至 2026 年 7 月 23 日，VIX 为 18.70，仍处于正常范围内。 艾夫斯的框架是，这正是多年扩张中健康整合的样子。

NVIDIA 论文：一颗芯片，12 比 1 的需求

NVIDIA（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）是艾夫斯争论的中心。 他说：“世界上有一种芯片推动了人工智能革命，那就是 Nvidia。”他补充道，“如今他们芯片的供应需求是 12 比 1。 物理人工智能甚至还没有开始发挥作用。”

最新的数据给这种观点带来了一定的影响。 2027 财年第一季度，NVIDIA 公布收入为 816.1 亿美元，同比增长 85.2%，非 GAAP 每股收益为 1.87 美元，而预期为 1.77 美元。 数据中心收入达到 752.5 亿美元，同比增长 92%，其中数据中心网络收入同比增长 199%，达到 148 亿美元。 管理层预计 2027 财年第二季度收入为 910 亿美元，上下浮动 2%（不包括中国数据中心计算）。 该公司在 2027 财年第一季度的 8-K 文件中披露，目前的供应承诺总额为 1,190 亿美元。

首席执行官黄仁勋将这一时刻描述为“人工智能工厂的建设，人类历史上最大规模的基础设施扩张，正在以惊人的速度加速。” 7 月 24 日，NVIDIA 股价收于 206.84 美元，今年以来该股已上涨 11.04%。 远期市盈率为 24，分析师一致目标为 302.83 美元。
